comment: Read from the maker's source at commit 3a9441f and manuals/README.md. The shift is held as a multiple of the frequency of C4: the knob runs -10 to 10 and is multiplied by two to the power of the range switch divided by dsp::FREQ_C4, and the range switch's nine positions are powers of two from 1 to 256 times ten hertz. The modulation input is added in those same units without passing through the range switch, so one volt at the top of the modulation knob is one whole C4, 261.63Hz. The result is clamped at a frequency ratio of 0.0009766, which is ten octaves below C4, so the output never falls below -10V. The maker's manual leaves the Root Octave, Frequency Shift and Frequency Modulation sections empty and mentions a root octave control that is not on the module.
